visualReview.notes: Inspected all 54 current frames: 9 portable, 9 shared, 25 medium-fi and 11 native. Original 85.14m asymmetric stone crossing with two dominant pointed arches, a lower south water arch and separate relief arch above it, three small south approach openings and a small north opening. Genuine through-openings, vault soffits, voussoir rims, broad projecting pier faces, coping, raised parapets and double-crested narrow walk remain across the complete browser levels. All source and opposite-side turntables, arch and paving details, lighting/context views, all native levels, both banks and failure view were inspected in the same authoring pass.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Three existing 256px shared graphs: stone_limestone, stone_limestone_raw and stone_drywall. Limestone walls/rims and irregular stone paving use metric UVs and component tints. No glazing, private or embedded images, downloaded meshes or copied photo pixels. Each graph is read once per resident fixture; skyline is one mean-color draw, other levels three draws. Separate position/normal GPU streams and complete disposal pass.
